ideas.title: Reduced spin-times-coherence d-wave kernel
ideas.quantitative_question: Does a coherence-weighted magnetic pairing kernel produce a more discriminating underdoped suppression signature than a spin-only kernel under identical assumed magnetic support?

candidate_model_strategy.rationale: A transparent comparator is required before any material-specific many-body calculation.

ideas.parameters_and_sources: All v0 values are declared MODEL_ASSUMPTION parameters for a sensitivity demonstration; they are not literature-derived material constants.
ideas.initial_boundary_requirements: p in [0.06,0.26] on a fixed 0.01 grid; positive pairing eigenvalue; common cutoff across scenarios.
ideas.falsification_condition: No underdoped discrimination after common-scale and uncertainty controls, or held-out data favor H0.
